items.title: Book Chronicling Stamps, Coins & Banknotes Issued During PM Narendra Modi’s 25 Years As Head Of Government Released

candidate_claims.text: Home Mumbai Book Chronicling Stamps, Coins & Banknotes Issued During PM Narendra Modi’s 25 Years As Head Of Government Released Book Chronicling Stamps, Coins & Banknotes Issued During PM Narendra Modi’s 25 Years As Head Of Government Released A 172-page book documenting stamps, coins and banknotes issued during Narendra Modi’s tenure as Gujarat Chief Minister and Prime Minister has been released.
Published by Mintage World, the compilation covers initiatives and milestones including Swachh Bharat, Atmanirbhar Bharat, Mann Ki Baat and 75 years of Independence.

FPJ News Service Updated: Thursday, October 08, 2026, 02:16 AM IST Book Chronicling Stamps, Coins & Banknotes Issued During PM Narendra Modi’s 25 Years As Head Of Government Released | Mumbai: A book containing information on the stamps, coins and banknotes issued during Narendra Modi’s 25-year tenure as Prime Minister and Chief Minister was released this month.

Public Initiatives Documented The book, titled Stamps, Coins, and Banknotes Issued During the Premiership of Shri Narendra Modi, Part 2, showcases public programmes and initiatives undertaken during his tenure, including Atmanirbhar Bharat, Beti Bachao Beti Padhao, Swachh Bharat Abhiyan, Covid-19 warriors, 75 years of Indian Independence, 125 years of Subhas Chandra Bose, 75 years of the CBI, 100 episodes of Mann Ki Baat, Modi’s public outreach programme, 100 years of Jamshedpur, the first industrial township in India, and Siachen Glacier, the world’s highest battlefield, among other subjects.
172-Page Compilation The 172-page compilation documents, in chronological order, the events and programmes, along with the coins, stamps and banknotes commemorating them.
